description:
Watch the official Super Bowl trailer for The Mandalorian and Grogu, the first Star Wars theatrical movie since 2019’s The Rise of Skywalker. Din Djarin (Pedro Pascal) and Grogu return for an epic new adventure — with snowy journeys, familiar faces, and new threats in a galaxy still rebuilding after the fall of the Empire. This brief but iconic Super Bowl spot gives fans a fresh look at what’s coming to theaters May 22, 2026.

📅 Release Date: May 22, 2026 (Theatrical)
🎥 Super Bowl Trailer: Official 30-second spot debuted during Super Bowl LX coverage
👨‍🚀 Starring: Pedro Pascal, Grogu, Sigourney Weaver, Jeremy Allen White
🎬 Director: Jon Favreau (with co-writer Dave Filoni)
